title: Step Up and Lead Right
paragraphs: Hey, what up? It's your boy Paul, and I'm on a special mission from God and Jesus. My whole deal is to get people hyped about the faith, especially God's chosen crew. I'm here to spill the real tea about God and how to live a life that's not totally lame. My goal is to get everyone stoked about eternal life. God promised this way back, and he's not the type to ghost on his promises. When the time was right, he dropped the truth on everyone, and I'm the one he picked to spread the word. So, to my main man Titus, my legit son in the faith: I hope you get all the good stuff from God our Father and our Savior, Jesus.

I bounced and left you in charge on that island, Crete, so you could finish up the stuff I didn't get to. You need to pick some leaders for each town, but don't just pick anyone. Make sure they're solid guys. Are they respected? Are they loyal to their wives? Are their kids cool and not always getting into trouble? A church leader has to be someone people look up to. He can't be a pushy bully, have a short fuse, be a party animal, a bully, or just in it for the cash. He's gotta be welcoming, helpful, smart, fair, and have his act together. Most importantly, he needs to have a solid grip on the message, so he can use the truth to either get people excited about learning or shut down the haters who are talking trash.

And trust me, there are a lot of haters out there. They're rebels, and they're full of hot air and lies. The worst ones are the religious fakes who should know better. You gotta shut them down. They're messing up whole families with their bogus teachings, just to make a quick buck. One of their own even said it: "Cretans are basically professional liars, savage beasts, and lazy slobs." And he wasn't wrong. So you gotta get in their face and stop all that nonsense about made-up rules and myths. That way, they can get back to having a real, strong faith. For people with clean minds, everything is clean. But for the dirtbags who don't believe, nothing is. They leave their grimy fingerprints on everything they think and do. They talk a big game about knowing God, but their actions show they're fakes. They're total frauds, disobedient, and good for nothing.

title: How to Not Be a Total Noob
paragraphs: Alright, Titus, here's the deal. You gotta tell everyone the real stuff, the solid truth. Tell the old guys to chill out, be respectable, and wise. They need to have legit faith, love, and not give up. And the older ladies? They need to be respectful and not be gossiping or getting ruined. They should be like, total role models. That way, the younger women can see how to love their husbands and kids, be good and pure, keep their homes clean, and be awesome wives. We don't want anyone dissing God's message because of how we act. Oh, and tell the young guys to get their lives together and be disciplined.

But for real, the best way to teach them is to just do it yourself. Be a living example. Be legit in what you teach, and don't say crazy stuff. Then, even the haters who are totally against us won't have anything to roast you about. They might even start to think you're not so bad after all.

Tell the workers to be loyal and a major plus to their bosses. No talking back, and no stealing from them or whatever. When they act with good character, it makes God's teachings look even better. It's like an amazing change for the faith.

God's ready to forgive everyone, and He's not keeping it a secret. Salvation is for everybody! He's showing us how to ghost our old, selfish lives and start living a life that's all about Him. This new life is starting now, and it's getting us hyped for the epic day when our awesome God and Savior, Jesus Christ, shows up. He sacrificed himself to save us from our dark, rebellious lives and make us into a squad He can be proud of, a team that's all about doing good things.
So, tell everyone this stuff. Hype them up, and if they get out of line, you gotta correct them. You're the leader here. Don't let anyone treat you like a scrub.

title: How to Be a Real G
paragraphs: Alright, listen up. Make sure everyone knows to respect the government and follow the rules. No need to be a rebel without a cause. Always be ready to help someone out. Don't be throwing shade or starting fights. God's crew should be known for being generous and cool to everyone.

And yo, don't forget where we came from. Not too long ago, we were the clueless ones, stubborn and getting played by our own bad habits. We were walking around with a chip on our shoulder, hating on people and getting hated on right back. But then God, our awesome and loving Savior, stepped in and showed his power. He saved us from all that mess. It was all Him; we didn't earn it. He gave us a major spiritual transformation, like an incredible renewal for our souls, all thanks to the Holy Spirit. Our main man Jesus hooked us up with this new life, big time. God's gift totally fixed our connection with Him and gave us our lives back. And the best part? There's a whole eternity of this awesome life to come. You can bet on that.

So, I need you to be firm on this stuff. Make sure all the believers are focused on doing good things that help everyone. Stay away from pointless arguments about who's related to who or getting bogged down in the fine print of old rules. That's just a waste of time and gets you nowhere. If someone just wants to argue for the sake of arguing, give them a warning or two, but if they don't stop, you gotta ghost them. It's clear they're on the wrong track and rebelling against God. By always trying to divide people, they're just cutting themselves off.

As soon as I send Artemas or Tychicus your way, hustle over and meet me in Nicopolis. I'm planning to spend the winter there. Make sure you give Zenas the lawyer and Apollos a proper send-off and take good care of them.

Our people need to learn to get to work and be productive. That way, everyone's needs are met, especially those who are struggling, and they'll have something to show for their lives instead of just wasting away.
Everyone here says 'sup. Give a shout-out to all our friends in the faith. Grace and peace to all of you.
